## 0.2.189

The panel's account row under the brand names the person and nothing else: the roles suffix
(`(admin)`, `(updater)`) is gone from every page, and Settings → Users still shows each account's
roles (a rendering change; nothing to migrate or configure).

The build declares the browser variable the layout test reads as an input of every test task, so a
run without it is no longer reported up-to-date (a build change; nothing to migrate or configure).
